categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Global Safety Technology Co., Ltd. (GSAFETY) operates primarily in public safety and emergency management software and equipment. Its main business segments include urban safety, emergency management, equipment and firefighting, consumer safety products, and overseas public safety services. The company provides integrated solutions combining software platforms and IoT intelligent hardware, serving government departments, enterprises, and consumers domestically and internationally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as AI large models, big data, cloud computing, IoT, BIM, GIS, and AIoT to develop its products and services. It has proprietary technologies in urban risk assessment, disaster chain analysis, sensor deployment optimization, gas leak detection, water leakage alarm, urban flood forecasting, and emergency command platforms. The equipment segment focuses on intelligent hardware manufacturing, including gas safety sensors, fire detection and suppression systems, and intelligent firefighting robots. The company emphasizes continuous R&D and innovation, including AI model integration and multi-model algorithm development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are government agencies at national, provincial, and local levels, including emergency management departments, urban infrastructure authorities, and public safety organizations. The company also serves enterprises, industrial parks, and consumers through its safety products. Overseas markets include developing countries in Latin America, Africa, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Central Asia, and countries along the Belt and Road Initiative. The company’s solutions address natural disasters, industrial accidents, public health emergencies, and social security incidents.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering all 32 provinces and over 300 cities and counties. Internationally, it has a presence in more than 30 countries and regions, including Latin America, Africa, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Central Asia, and the Belt and Road countries. Key domestic regions include Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Southwest, Central China, Northwest, and special administrative regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Global Safety Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the public safety industry supply chain. It develops and manufactures intelligent hardware (equipment segment) and provides software platforms and integrated solutions (software and services segment). The company also offers ongoing operation, maintenance, and cloud services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or pure distributor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on becoming a global leader in innovative public safety technology. It prioritizes R&D in AI large models, multi-modal disaster simulation, urban risk monitoring, and intelligent emergency command systems. Key projects include the 'Chensi' public safety industry large model, comprehensive emergency panorama, emergency command and rescue dispatch systems, and urban resilience data platforms. It emphasizes integration of AI, IoT, and cloud computing to enhance intelligent safety management and emergency response capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of software platforms, intelligent hardware, and integrated safety solutions. The company also earns income from technical services, system integration, operation and maintenance services, and cloud-based monitoring services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales teams, government tenders, and partnerships with integrators and ecosystem partners. Pricing includes standard product pricing and customized solutions based on client requirements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading high-tech enterprise in China’s public safety and emergency management sector, with strong ties to Tsinghua University and China Telecom. It holds a dominant position in urban safety and emergency management platforms, with proprietary technologies and extensive intellectual property. Competitors include other domestic public safety technology firms and international players in emergency management software and hardware. The company differentiates itself through deep integration of AI, IoT, and cloud technologies and comprehensive solution offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.4 billion, a decline of about 38% from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -322 million. The company’s total assets were about RMB 4.23 billion at year-end. Despite revenue decline due to contract delays and market conditions, the company improved cash flow from operations significantly. R&D investment remained robust at over RMB 147 million, representing about 10.5% of revenue. The company serves a broad domestic and international market with over 300 city-level clients and more than 30 overseas countries.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique value in providing integrated, AI-enabled public safety and emergency management solutions that combine software platforms with IoT intelligent hardware. Its products enable proactive risk management, real-time monitoring, early warning, and efficient emergency response across urban infrastructure and public safety domains. Leveraging proprietary AI large models and extensive sensor networks, it offers differentiated capabilities in disaster simulation, multi-source data fusion, and intelligent decision support. The company’s close collaboration with Tsinghua University and China Telecom enhances its innovation capacity and market reach.
